cards.headline:
AI could make films costlier
than in the 35mm era
cards.body: A 100-minute AI feature can top $366,000 in tokens, and each revision is a paid re-render, Kim Kwang-jib warned.

blocks.x: At TCCF in Taipei, Studio Meta-K CEO Kim Kwang-jib said the token bill alone for a 100-minute AI feature can top KRW500 million ($366,000) with top commercial tools.
Every revision is a paid re-render, he added, so piecemeal client notes can multiply costs tenfold.
He and MBC C&I's Lee Sang-wook, whose AI feature 'Raphael' heads to Korean cinemas, also covered hybrid shoots and new crew roles.
